purpose: Official same-form Rust release references for the strict per-artifact size gate. Every entry was verified by downloading the public GitHub release asset and matching the GitHub API SHA-256 digest (M26 survey; independently re-downloaded and re-hashed for this file). Entries here take priority over the same-host pinned baseline.json and the documented historical anchors.

desktop-nsis-windows-amd64.form: NSIS installer for the Rust Windows desktop amd64

desktop-dmg-darwin-arm64.form: DMG for the Rust macOS desktop arm64; the same-host baseline.json DMG (14987015 B) is a different build of the same name and both are citable, the release asset is publicly verifiable

server-archive-full-linux-amd64.form: whole-archive comparison against the Go full server archive
server-archive-full-linux-amd64.contents_difference: The Rust archive is a single-binary full server: nexterm-server ELF, web/ frontend, nexterm-server.service, one env example, README and LICENSE. The Go full archive intentionally carries both runtime units (nexterm-server.service and nexterm-onlyserver.service) and both env examples because restricted --sync-only is a runtime mode of the same binary, not a separate onlyServer package. Whole-archive bytes remain the like-for-like rule; the content difference is stated here and in the artifact report, never hidden.

server-linux-amd64.form: stripped ELF x86-64 (dynamic libc/libm/libgcc_s) inside the official full server archive; supersedes the smaller pre-release dev cross-build anchor in historical-metrics.json

desktop-darwin-arm64.form: Mach-O arm64 inside the official macOS app archive; container NexTerm_aarch64.app.tar.gz is 12371322 B sha256 984bbcce06a9be1321b5d2f43d2852cd0d246188abd8736deb190107f0fd9d52

genuinely_unavailable.note: No official Rust release (v0.1.0-v0.2.1) ever produced these same-form artifacts; per the release contract they stay evidence-gap and must never be reported as passed.
